items.item_text: This position requires a minimum of two (2) days/week on campus/on-site.
Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.
Occasional evenings and weekends may be required.

Mandated reporter under CANRA. Duties may require direct contact with children (defined as individuals under the age of 18). Completion of the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (CANRA) form will be required.
Cover letter required for a complete application.

Acquiring knowledge of organization's human resource management system (HRMS) and other related business software programs and systems. Experience with UCPath or other payroll/HR systems and ability to use data processing software and relational database systems to process full range of personnel actions (recruitment, timekeeping, merit increases, funding changes, etc.). Ability to conceptualize, develop and utilize new systems, reports and tools for data retrieval, analysis and review.

Acquiring knowledge and experience in managing international scholar services, including proficiency in visa procedures (e.g., J-1, H-1B, OPT/STEM OPT), policies, immigration laws pertaining to foreign scholars, appointment workflows and onboarding.

Reporting to the Academic Personnel Manager, the incumbent provides operational human resources support for Visiting Scholars, Visiting Graduate Students (VGS), Visiting Research Scholar Interns and Academic Volunteers across the Jacobs School of Engineering.

Working under general supervision, this role assists supervisors, managers and staff with routine academic HR inquiries and issues of limited scope. The incumbent supports daily academic HR activities across recruitment, employee and labor relations intake, compensation and classification processing, merit reviews, Leaves of Absence (LOA)/FMLA tracking, workplace accommodation requests, worker’s compensation coordination, and organizational changes.

Additionally, this position processes standard personnel transactions in UCPath such as appointments, salary adjustments, reclassifications, and separations while maintaining accurate payroll funding allocations, updating personnel records and coordinating onboarding and offboarding procedures. The position applies established university policies, assists with routine guidelines, provides administrative support. Escalating moderate/complex or non-routine issues to the Academic Personnel Manager, Team Lead or colleagues.

The incumbent supports the administration of Visiting Scholar appointments across the Jacobs School of Engineering, managing appointments, ensuring eligibility and requirements are met. The incumbent monitors appointment milestones, coordinating reappointments and appointment end dates, while conducting orientations covering UC policies, required training and safety requirements.

As a member of the Jacobs School of Engineering AP Service Center team, this position provides backup support to their colleagues on projects of limited scope and complexity. Receives instructions on most work assignments and regularly consults with senior team members and/or Academic Personnel Manager while completing tasks. Exercises some judgment within defined procedures and policies to determine appropriate action. The incumbent will support file preparation and review for all types of departmental academic appointees, including senate faculty, professional researchers, adjuncts, and Unit 18 Lecturers. Will also assist with the academic recruitment process including providing non-complex staff support to faculty review committees or the Chair. Participates in faculty meetings, initiates and coordinates recruitment efforts, appointments, advancements, visas, and recalls.
Support special projects and other duties as assigned. Provide operational support to team members by assisting with routine administrative workflows.
~ Cover letter required for a complete application.
Acquiring knowledge of and ability to apply / interpret organization and college policies and procedures which govern academic HR.
Acquiring knowledge of organization, college, and departmental formal and informal policies and procedures, and understanding of variances to stated policies.
Acquiring knowledge of unit academic culture and educational goals of discipline(s) served.

Analytical skills to conduct analysis and develop recommendations, demonstrating organizational and problem-solving skills. Ability to prioritize, follow through on tasks, handle multiple tasks simultaneously, and meet deadlines independently; respond to urgent requests with the demonstrated ability to function well in a high-volume environment with frequent interruptions

Skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and interact with a diverse group of individuals from within and outside the university, using tact, diplomacy, and sensitivity; ability to develop and maintain good working relationships with employees, faculty, managers, supervisors and campus administrators. Ability to explain policies, procedures, and other concepts in easily understandable terms
Willingness and demonstrated ability to embrace and consistently uphold the principles of community for a collaborative work environment.

Demonstrated ability to learn new methods for computer aided data reporting/retrieval, new computer applications, data and word processing software and relational database systems. Demonstrated skill to extract, compile and analyze data to write clear and concise reports.

Ability to prioritize, follow through on tasks, handle multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines independently. Respond to urgent requests with the demonstrated ability to function well in a high-volume environment with frequent interruptions. Ability to work independently and exercise good judgement to identify problems and recommend reasonable course of action for problem resolution.
Proven ability to maintain strict confidentiality and use discretionary practices.
Ability to use project management platforms (such as ClickUp) to streamline HR workflows, track deliverables, ensure accountability and optimize operations.
